findings.text: follow-on: _resolve_canonical returns the first validating canonical candidate without checking for a second claimant, so when include_archived is true the archived route in resolve_route returns the live resource for a slug that has both a live and an archived document and reports it not-found, where the scan raised ResourceCollision for the same pair; the docstring's "every collision case keep the full scan" is not what the code does.

item_verdicts.diff: read the single commit 1500780fa against base 4cd309a0e; it adds _declared_north_stars and the file_memo-backed diagnostic in reckon/_store.py, _canonical_resource_at and _resolve_canonical wired into resolve_resource in reckon/resources.py, the new test file and a landing fragment, 331 insertions and 11 deletions across the four paths.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when requires os.scandir parity between 5- and 60-plan fixtures, payload equality with the scan path, a logged negative control where the done-when has a 60-plan count exceeding the 5-plan count, and a warm fleet-node call inside 30 s; tests/test_one_plan_read_is_not_a_corpus_scan.py:161 asserts the parity and :148 asserts payload equality, negative-control.log records 22 vs 132 EXIT=1, and fleet-warm-read.log records warm 0.039 s against a 12.613 s cold read.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is "make a read_plan summary of one plan resolve that plan without a corpus scan, as plan section 9 specifies"; the diff adds a canonical-path fast path in reckon/resources.py:646 resolve_resource and drops the whole-state composition behind the north-star diagnostic to a memoised lookup at reckon/_store.py:683, so a one-plan read resolves its document directly and the diagnostic cost is paid once.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the head test passing EXIT=0, the negative control failing EXIT=1 at 22 vs 132, the fleet warm read at 0.039 s, and the focused 104-test suite green at both the base 4cd309a0e and the head 1500780fa, and it names each of those logs on disk.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths; the diff's four files (reckon/resources.py, reckon/_store.py, tests/test_one_plan_read_is_not_a_corpus_scan.py, docs/evidence/fragments/an-mcp-failure-names-its-cause/one-plan-read-is-not-a-corpus-scan.html) are all inside the declared scope.

justifications.durability: tests/test_one_plan_read_is_not_a_corpus_scan.py:157 asserts forced_large > forced_small > 0 and :161 asserts small_count == large_count, both of which redden when resources._resolve_canonical is reverted to None (negative-control.log), and the payload-parity assertion at :148 compares the direct path against the scan path rather than against its own input.
justifications.evidence: negative-control.log records the scan path diverging 22 vs 132 EXIT=1 and fleet-warm-read.log records 0.039 s, so each done-when clause is measured and logged rather than claimed.
justifications.fit: reckon/resources.py:613 and reckon/_store.py:683 follow the surrounding private-helper docstring idiom and carry no plan or stage label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/resources.py:646 resolve_resource now returns the canonical file for a named plan before scanning, and reckon/_store.py:712 memoises the diagnostic so a warm one-plan read is flat in corpus size.
justifications.reuse: reckon/resources.py:562 _canonical_resource_at reuses canonical_relative_path, canonical_href and ResourceIdentity rather than re-deriving the canonical path, and reckon/_store.py:712 takes its memo from file_memo.memoized rather than adding a cache of its own.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff (reckon/resources.py, reckon/_store.py, tests/test_one_plan_read_is_not_a_corpus_scan.py, docs/evidence/fragments/an-mcp-failure-names-its-cause/one-plan-read-is-not-a-corpus-scan.html) is inside the manifest's declared write paths and no other file is touched.
